info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Limit Adjustment API
info.description: The Credit Limit Adjustment API allows businesses to modify existing credit limits for their customers efficiently. By using this API, financial institutions can adjust credit limits based on changing customer needs, risk assessments, or new business requirements. This endpoint is essential for maintaining up-to-date financial profiles and ensuring that credit offerings align with real-time evaluations. Typical users include financial service applications, customer relationship management systems, and internal banking tools that require seamless credit management capabilities.
